Corollary
[Proposition 4, Recovered from the Recursion]

↗ prop:gram-schmidt-bilin-orthonormal ↗ lem:gram-schmidt-bilin-normed-flag

Every nondegenerate tuple for a symmetric bilinear form admits an orthonormal tuple with the same prefix spans.

Proof

↗ prop:gram-schmidt-bilin-orthonormal ↗ lem:gram-schmidt-bilin-normed-flag \sketch Take $b=\widehat{\mathrm{GS}}_B(v)$ and apply the preceding proposition and lemma.

□
